create_RRT_planner: create an RRT planner with a ConfigurationSpace and validation function for motion planning
run_RRT_plan: run the RRT plan method to find a path from start to goal state
run_RRT_step_planner: run a single step of the RRT planner for anytime planning with optional goal sampling
create_TreeNode_backup: create a TreeNode and call backup to retrieve the full planned path as a list of nodes
reset_RRT_planner: reset the RRT planner to clear nodes, goal state, and start time for a new planning run
